channel.description: Latest articles from Church and State (churchandstate.org.uk)

item.title: Trump’s attempts at foreign policy forecast immediate and long-term trouble for the United States
item.description: One of America’s greatest assets in the recent past has been its system of alliances with other countries, such as NATO. Trump disapproves.

item.title: Could Trump in the midterms be indicted by Congress if massive screams came from us and responsible mass media?
item.description: There should be no time to lose in demanding that the spineless GOP senators quickly indict and evict Trump.

item.title: The Global Catholic Church is Losing Members Because of the Clerical Sexual Torture of Children
item.description: The Catholic Church has created a global catastrophe through its careful maintenance of a system that has allowed clergy to abuse children.

item.title: Overpopulation: The Global Challenge and Its Far-reaching Impacts
item.description: Overpopulation exerts pressure on the environment, exacerbating the depletion of natural resources, and contributing to ecological degradation.

item.title: How long can humans live?
item.description: Life expectancy at birth overall has been steadily increasing for many years. It has more than doubled in the last two centuries.

item.title: Will Superintelligence cause our extinction or pave the way for a human species evolution?
item.description: There are top AI scientists who all point to 2030 as the time by when we will lose control over the (self)development of AI.

item.title: Are Trump’s numerous misdeeds too many to track? No indeed!
item.description: Trump's probable loss of the House of Representatives will hardly be adequate to fix his trait of using his office as a personal profit machine.

item.title: The Old Lessons of Tyranny Are Knocking at America’s Door
item.description: Today, Trump seeks to intimidate law abiding citizens, especially those in states that did not support him.

item.title: ‘We Are Running Out of Time’: 2025 Keeps Hot Streak Alive for Global Temperatures
item.description: For the first time global temperatures over a three-year period have exceeded the critical threshold of 1.5°C above preindustrial levels.

item.title: A safer approach to gene editing
item.description: Researchers used virus proteins to deliver the CRISPR system into cells for faster and safer gene editing.
